title: Session of Faith Presbyterian Church, Akron, Ohio, et al. v. Presbytery of Ascension
disposition_detail: The specification of continued noncompliance was sustained; the alleged constitutional violation and contumacy were not sustained. Recommendations for remedial action were adopted, but their terms are absent from the supplied text.
first_summary: The complainants challenged Presbytery’s May 1984 resolution as continued defiance of directions issued in an earlier ordination case. The complaint was sustained as to continued noncompliance but not as to constitutional violation or contumacy, and remedial recommendations were adopted. The supplied record gives no adjudicative reasoning or text of the remedies.
summary: A Session and other complainants challenged Presbytery’s May 1984 resolution as continued noncompliance with directions from an earlier ordination case. The continued-noncompliance specification was sustained, but allegations of constitutional violation and contumacy were not sustained. Remedial recommendations were adopted, although the supplied excerpt provides neither their terms nor the deciding body’s reasons. The mixed ruling therefore distinguishes noncompliance from the complainants’ more serious characterizations of Presbytery’s conduct.
